question: Where will the first World Super Kabaddi League be held in 2026?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Dubai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Inaugural edition of World Super Kabaddi League to be held in Dubai.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **World Super Kabaddi League (WSKL)** will hold its **inaugural edition** in **Dubai**, tentatively in **February–March 2026**.

 
 
• 
 
The event is backed by the **International Kabaddi Federation (IKF)**.

 
 
• 
 
It will feature a **franchise-based model** with **eight teams**.

 
 
• 
 
The tournament is expected to include **players from around 30 countries**.

 
 
• 
 
A **total player purse of ₹48 crore** has been allocated across franchises.
